title: ViewerSidecar
description: Attributes on the top-level `viewer` zarr group (backend/app/persistence/store.py:_write_viewer_sidecar). Mirrored on read by frontend/src/data/checkpointSource.ts's ViewerSidecar interface. Documented in docs/CHECKPOINT_FORMAT.md.

images.description: image element name -> (table key, or "" for none) -> ImageInfo.

coords_transform.description: table key -> 6-float affine applied to that table's obsm:spatial to reach the global coordinate system.

figures.description: plots[].id -> format -> byte length of viewer/figures/<plot_id>/<format>, a uint8 array holding that file's bytes. Absent (or empty) in a checkpoint saved without figures; a plot listed here is the only kind that reloads as `drawn`. The lengths are carried here so a reader can size a figure (and the app can list them in the save dialog) without opening every array.

shapes.description: Polygonal shapes element name -> the spatial-index report for its shapes.parquet (backend/app/persistence/store.py:_index_shapes). Absent in a checkpoint written before the index existed, whose boundaries a range-reading client leaves unread. Only indexed elements appear: point/circle shapes and `annotations` are absent, as are empty elements. A companion `viewer/shapes/<element>/<table>/cell_index` int32 array gives each parquet row its obs row position.

shape_index.description: What the viewer needs to plan a range query against one shapes element without reading it first.

bounds.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the element's intrinsic space — the space the covering bbox statistics are in, which the viewer reaches by inverting coords_transform.

selectivity.description: Median fraction of the element extent covered by one row group. Ideal is 1/row_groups; near 1.0 means the rows are not spatially sorted and pruning will not pay.

affine6.description: [a,b,c,d,e,f]: x' = a*x + b*y + c, y' = d*x + e*y + f.

image_info.description: backend/app/imaging.py:image_info(), baked as-is. Byte-for-byte comparable to GET /api/sessions/{id}/image/{element}/info's pixel_to_world/bounds/is_rgb/contrast_limits/contrast_range/channel_names/width/height.

bounds.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1], axis-aligned world bounds of the full image.
